summary: Iran's IRGC fired ballistic missiles at two U.S. warships, prompting CENTCOM to destroy three IRGC oil tankers in the Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman. Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon killed at least four and wounded 20, with additional attacks reported in Arabsalim, Roman, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, and the Beqaa Valley. Israel launched a large-scale exercise in Eilat and the Arava simulating a multi-domain surprise attack while the U.S. approved a $5 billion arms sale to Saudi Arabia.
key_points: IRGC ballistic missiles targeted a U.S. aircraft carrier and destroyer; CENTCOM retaliated by destroying three IRGC crude tankers near Kharg Island, Jask, and in the Gulf of Oman. (Source: @VahidOnline/78241)
Lebanese Health Ministry reported four killed and 20 wounded in Israeli morning raids on southern Lebanon. (Source: @N12chat/225171)
Al-Mayadeen reported at least two killed in an Israeli strike on the village of Arabsalim in southern Lebanon. (Source: @New_security8200/203626)
Artillery shelling on the village of Roman in southern Lebanon wounded five people. (Source: @yediotnews25/134685)
A drone attack on a vehicle in southern Lebanon caused casualties. (Source: @yediotnews25/134682)
Israeli military began a major exercise in Eilat and the Arava simulating surprise attack from air, sea, and land. (Source: @yediotnews25/134688)
U.S. State Department approved a $5 billion sale of bombs, guidance kits, and military equipment to Saudi Arabia. (Source: @VahidOnline/78239)
Iranian parliamentary security committee stated Iran is in a defensive posture and in an "existential war" with the United States. (Source: @New_security8200/203631)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's IRGC fired ballistic missiles at two U.S. warships, prompting CENTCOM to destroy three IRGC oil tankers in the Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman. Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon killed at least four and wounded 20, with additional attacks reported in Arabsalim, Roman, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, and the Beqaa Valley. Israel launched a large-scale exercise in Eilat and the Arava simulating a multi-domain surprise attack while the U.S. approved a $5 billion arms sale to Saudi Arabia.

points: IRGC Aerospace Force fired multiple ballistic missiles at a U.S. aircraft carrier and a guided-missile destroyer operating in regional waters; both vessels withdrew after sustaining damage, according to an IRGC statement. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80382)

In response, U.S. CENTCOM forces destroyed three IRGC-operated crude oil tankers: M/T Downy near Kharg Island, M/T Stark 1 near Jask, and the empty M/T Kylo (also known as Noxen) in the Gulf of Oman, permanently disabling them. (Source: @VahidOnline/78241)

UKMTO reported that several commercial vessels in the northern Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman were targeted by gunfire in the context of ongoing military activities, indicating broader maritime threat. (Source: @VahidOnline/78244)
A channel reported "Iranians firing at the Strait of Hormuz," suggesting possible IRGC actions in the strategic waterway. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94314)

The Iranian parliament's national security committee spokesman told Al Jazeera that Iran is in a defensive state, adhering to understandings but facing U.S. escalation, describing the situation as an "existential war" with the United States. (Source: @New_security8200/203631)
Satellite imagery showed a thermal anomaly at Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG facility with 80-120 MW heat signatures, though cause unconfirmed. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89442)

The IDF's 80th Division will lead a large-scale exercise starting tomorrow in Eilat and the Arava, involving IDF, police, and MDA simulating extreme surprise attack scenarios including combined air, sea, and ground infiltration. (Source: @yediotnews25/134688)
Israeli artillery struck the village of Roman in southern Lebanon, wounding five people according to Lebanese reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/134685)
An Israeli drone attacked a vehicle in southern Lebanon, resulting in fatalities at the scene. (Source: @yediotnews25/134682)
Israeli warplanes were observed heading toward the Beqaa Valley in eastern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/40994, @redlinkleb/40995)
An Israeli airstrike hit Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/40960)
A conference of hostage families in Jaffa aimed to promote legislation for hostage survivors' rights and rehabilitation. (Source: @N12chat/225174)

U.S. Ambassador Mike Huckabee met Palestinian families of U.S. citizens killed by Israeli settlers in Turmus Ayya, West Bank, where 80% of residents are Palestinian Americans. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6838)
Hostage families organization 255 held a conference in Jaffa to advance legislation for hostage survivors' rights and rehabilitation. (Source: @N12chat/225174)
Lebanese Health Ministry reported four killed and 20 wounded in Israeli morning raids on southern Lebanon. (Source: @N12chat/225171, @rasedal3ado138e/389165)
Al-Mayadeen reported at least two killed in an Israeli strike on the village of Arabsalim in southern Lebanon. (Source: @New_security8200/203626)
Lebanese media reported five wounded by artillery shelling targeting the village of Roman in southern Lebanon. (Source: @yediotnews25/134685)
A drone strike on a vehicle in southern Lebanon caused fatalities. (Source: @yediotnews25/134682)
Artillery shelling hit the area of Doha Kfar Reman in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/40988)
An airstrike targeted Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/40960)
Warplanes were detected heading toward the Beqaa Valley in eastern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/40994, @redlinkleb/40995)
Saudi media reported Hezbollah received an Iranian "green light" to withdraw from the Ali Taher ridge. (Source: @New_security8200/203639)

U.S. State Department approved a $5 billion sale of bombs, guidance kits, and other military equipment to Saudi Arabia to enhance its air defense against regional threats and improve interoperability with U.S. systems. (Source: @VahidOnline/78239)
Three U.S. Air Force KC-46A tankers (RCH096, RCH097, RCH098) departed Fairchild AFB sequentially, indicating possible aerial refueling support for regional operations. (Source: @shin_persian/9473)
UKMTO reported multiple commercial vessels targeted by gunfire in the northern Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman amid ongoing military activities. (Source: @VahidOnline/78244)
Satellite data showed unusual thermal activity at Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG facility with 80-120 MW heat signatures detected by VIIRS and Terra satellites. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89442)
Press TV reported Yemen's roads and bridges devastated by years of war and blockade. (Source: @presstv/205702)
Pro-government forces in Yemen shot down two Houthi FPV drones and a reconnaissance drone along the western coast fronts. (Source: @shin_persian/9466)

key_developments: IRGC ballistic missile attack on U.S. aircraft carrier and destroyer forced both warships to withdraw; CENTCOM responded by destroying three IRGC oil tankers (M/T Downy, M/T Stark 1, M/T Kylo) in Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman. (Source: @VahidOnline/78241, @rodast_omiddana/80382)

Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon killed at least four and wounded 20 per Lebanese Health Ministry, with additional strikes in Arabsalim (2 killed), Roman (5 wounded), Nabatieh al-Fawqa, and a drone strike on a vehicle causing fatalities. (Source: @N12chat/225171, @New_security8200/203626, @yediotnews25/134685, @yediotnews25/134682, @redlinkleb/40960)
Israel launched major multi-domain exercise in Eilat/Arava simulating surprise attack from air, sea, and land involving 80th Division, police, and MDA. (Source: @yediotnews25/134688)
U.S. approved $5 billion arms package to Saudi Arabia including bombs and guidance kits to bolster air defense and interoperability with U.S. forces in Gulf. (Source: @VahidOnline/78239)
UKMTO reported commercial vessels targeted by gunfire in northern Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman amid ongoing military activities. (Source: @VahidOnline/78244)

Iranian parliamentary security committee declared Iran in defensive posture and "existential war" with U.S., warning of more severe attacks on U.S. warships if escalation continues. (Source: @New_security8200/203631, @New_security8200/203626)
Saudi sources claim Hezbollah received Iranian permission to withdraw from Ali Taher ridge; Israeli warplanes observed over Beqaa Valley. (Source: @New_security8200/203639, @redlinkleb/40994)
sections.threat_assessment: The direct IRGC ballistic missile attack on U.S. warships marks a significant escalation in Iran-U.S. confrontation, moving beyond proxy warfare to state-on-state kinetic action. CENTCOM's destruction of three IRGC tankers demonstrates a calibrated but lethal response
